weights: Same last full-attention block V/O/down LoRA; no added trainable layers
hypothesis: Correction rehearsal, task balance, canonical JSON and description-first drafts reduce under-learning and early title drift; combined intervention, not isolated attribution.
selection: Fixed 3 epochs; final cases must not select a checkpoint
gate: Numeric and general scores at least both base and parent, strict complete-draft coverage greater than both. Passing only permits broader release evaluation, not deployment.
draftReview: Non-blind; preserve all explicit facts/exclusions, no invented scope or conditions, only explicitly open questions; inspect title and body.
